snippet.title: Reroll or Die - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5249180/Reroll_or_Die_Demo/

Reroll or Die is a roguelike deck-builder where everything is decided by dice rolls. Yes, even the start button. But fortunately you can turn the odds in your favor: reroll, upgrade, invert, split, combine, increase or decrease your rolls, then slot them into your weapon and armor cards.
